stack:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Recursively builds the output array a by repeatedly removing a candidate element b[i] that equals i+1, recursing on the reduced array, and writing i+1 or -1 into the current position depending on success." stack]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> b </REF>: int* "Input array of candidate values; the active prefix has length m."
        <REF> a </REF>: int* "Output array that is modified in place with the constructed values or -1 failure sentinels."
        <REF> m </REF>: int "Problem size; the number of active elements considered from b and the highest index plus one to fill in a. Assumed to be at least 1."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> a </REF>: int* "Modified in place to contain the constructed sequence, with -1 at positions that cannot be completed."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND If m == 1, set a[0] = 1 when b[0] == 1, otherwise set a[0] = -1; then return from this call. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND If m > 1, scan i from 0 to m-1 and break as soon as b[i] > i+1. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND If the pre-scan loop broke early (i != m), set a[m-1] = -1 and return from this call. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND If the pre-scan loop completed (i == m), initialize flag = 0. RESULT flag]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to m-1, execute the backtracking loop: if b[i] != i+1, copy b[i] into new_b[i]; if b[i] == i+1, process it as a candidate. RESULT new_b]
            [COMMAND In the candidate case b[i] == i+1, create new_b as b with b[i] removed by shifting b[i+1..m-1] into new_b[i..m-2]; together with earlier copies this makes new_b equal b without b[i]. RESULT new_b]
            [COMMAND In the candidate case, recursively call stack(new_b, a, m-1). RESULT a]
            [COMMAND In the candidate case, if a[m-2] == -1 after the recursive call, set new_b[i] = b[i] and continue to the next i. RESULT new_b]
            [COMMAND In the candidate case, if a[m-2] != -1 after the recursive call, set a[m-1] = i + 1, set flag = 1, and break out of the loop. RESULT flag]
            [COMMAND After the backtracking loop, if flag == 0, set a[m-1] = -1. RESULT a]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
